sentences.text: Jiaodontus was an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish, a group belonging to the class Chondrichthyes.
The genus is defined by its type species, J. montaltissimus, which serves as the reference for the group.
Klug, Tütken, Wings, Pfretzschner, and Martin first described the genus in 2010, including the species J. montaltissimus and J. vedenemus.
These animals lived during the Oxfordian age of the Late Jurassic in northwestern China, where fossils were found in the Qigu Formation.
